note: Security and bug fixes. Bridge: new vespera.bridge.exposed-apps allowlist for the client-controlled X-Vespera-App header (unlisted apps get a 404 from the proxy without dispatch; unset logs a one-time WARN), and the app-selection header is no longer forwarded to Rust; application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies consumed by Spring FormContentFilter or an earlier getParameter() (e.g. CsrfFilter) are rebuilt from the request parameters with a corrected Content-Length (form requests routed to bidirectional streaming are served as STREAMING). Wire: header values use a Latin-1 byte<->char mapping, so non-ASCII response header values (e.g. a UTF-8 Content-Disposition filename) are no longer dropped and servlet request header bytes reach Rust unchanged (values containing a char above U+00FF keep UTF-8). Cron: vespera! starts its jobs once per process via cron::start_once, without panicking outside a Tokio runtime (dedicated scheduler thread), and #[cron] jobs in modules expanded after vespera! are recovered by a module-tree scan.
